description: List free, public InkQuest stories. Each card has the title, level (HSK for Chinese, CEFR for English), genre, a short description, and the public reading URL https://inkquest.dev/stories/{id}. Optional filters: target_language (zh or en), hsk_level (Chinese stories only), and genre. Does not include subscriber-only scenes, withdrawn demos, or user-generated stories.

genre.description: Genre or keyword, such as mystery, romance, xianxia, comedy, or science fiction. Case-insensitive.

hsk_level.description: HSK band for Chinese stories. Use an integer 1-9 or a string like "HSK 4". Does not apply to English CEFR stories.

target_language.description: Learning language: zh for Chinese stories, en for English stories.

name: list_stories
title: List public stories
